Maria G.: Heads-up: seeing ~6-9% tail latency regression on SM90 when the runtime picks the FlashX-paged kernel vs the CUDA-fused kernel for short sequences (<=32). PerfBot flagged it in nightly runs.
PerfBot: Nightly perf run summary: model=gpt-small, seq=16/32, batch=8. p50/p95 increased ~7%/12% on sm90 vs sm80 when kernel=flashx-paged. Compare run id 2023-11-05-119.
Kevin L.: Can you paste the selector decision log + a quick flamegraph? Did this start after the allocator / prefetch handshake change?
Maria G.: Attaching quick gprof dump and the current selector heuristic snippet we use:
```
selector:
  - cond: seq_len <= 32 and arch == 'sm90' and cuda >= 12.1
    prefer: flashx-paged
  - cond: batch_size >= 16
    prefer: fused-cuda
  - cond: kv_cached and prefix_len > 64
    prefer: paged-opt
```
Sanjay R.: We intentionally tuned flashx-paged for long seqs. Suspect the prefetch handshake path is misfiring on sm90 for short seqs — maybe register pressure / different tensorcore mapping.
Elaine H.: Could be warp scheduling differences on SM90. FlashX-paged v2 uses a different fragment tiling that might increase divergence for tiny sequences. Can you repro with `--profile-kernel`?
Maria G.: Reproducible with `--profile-kernel`. Sample perf snippet:
```
kernel: flashx_paged_v2
occupancy: 0.62
l2_bw: 74GB/s
sched_stalls: 18%
shared_bank_conflicts: 4%
inst_issued_per_warp: 320
```
Kevin L.: If we force `fused-cuda` for seq<=32 on SM90 it recovers baseline p95. Suggest we make selector more conservative until we patch the kernel.
PerfBot: A/B experiment run 2323456700: forced fused-cuda for seq<=32 -> p95 back to baseline, tokens/sec +1.2% (cost roughly neutral).
Sanjay R.: Proposed runtime fallback rule: add a dynamic threshold — if flashx_paged p95 > fused p95 * 1.03 for the same workload, choose fused. Also add quick microbench on sm90 hardware in CI.
Maria G.: I'll schedule a canary tonight with the selector tweak and open a kernel bug for FlashX-paged v2 codegen. CC @Elaine H. for a minimal repro and a microbench.
Elaine H.: 👍 I'll prepare a small CUDA repro and a microbench that isolates the warp divergence. Note: CUDA 12.2 nightly emits slightly different SASS for the same PTX; need to test both 12.1 and 12.2.
InfraBot: Canary scheduled on `sm90-pool-2` at 03:00 UTC. Roll plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m monitors and automatic rollback if p95 regresses > 5%.
Maria G.: Thanks. TL;DR: selector currently over-prefers flashx-paged on SM90 for short seqs. Plan: canary runtime selector tweak tonight, run microbench + kernel patch if needed. Will post results in this thread. :white_check_mark:
